name: io.github.Servosity/domotz-mcp
title: Domotz MCP
description: Every Domotz endpoint, plus a local SQLite fleet mirror that answers cross-site questions.

environmentVariables.name: DOMOTZ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the DOMOTZ_API_KEY credential for the Domotz MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: DOMOTZ_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from DOMOTZ_REGION. Set it only to point at a different host.

environmentVariables.name: DOMOTZ_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Selects the Domotz API cell for your portal (default us-east-1-cell-1).

environmentVariables.name: DOMOTZ_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every write from the MCP server (read tools only).

environmentVariables.name: DOMOTZ_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses (reads go to the API).

environmentVariables.name: DOMOTZ_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Domotz requests.

environmentVariables.name: DOMOTZ_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (at least 32 characters). Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the default client profile.
